boundaries: Factor-based accounting identities only; atmospheric physics, dispersion modeling and lifecycle assessment are excluded.
Emission factors and warming potentials are supplied inputs with stated vintage, gas and horizon, never assumed constants.
Exponential decay, half-life and discounting forms must be deferred with sources, never approximated.
Every intensity states its numerator, denominator and period explicitly; no hidden allocation across products or years.
Expressions must be written in canonical base units of the runtime registry; never inline a conversion factor that belongs to unit scales (see the canonical-units rule).
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent source chapters/subtopics inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
integration_expectation: New meanings (emission_mass, emission_intensity, carbon_dioxide_equivalent, diversion_rate, water_intensity and similar) and units (t, kt, Mt, tCO2e and similar) require extension; all seed forms are scalar and fit the engine once meanings exist.
mission: Curate atomic reusable algebraic environmental-accounting relationships: emission masses, intensities, CO2-equivalent conversion and diversion rates, each with explicit gas, vintage and boundary scope. Factor accounting only; continue through successive batches with no inference chain required.
priorities: Emission mass from activity amount and emission factor
CO2-equivalent mass from gas mass and warming potential over a stated horizon
Emission intensity from emission mass and output quantity
Waste diversion rate from diverted and total waste masses
special_checks: Guard nonnegative masses and positive denominators; state the accounting boundary (Scope text, facility, year) in context
Keep warming-potential horizon (GWP100 and similar) in the meaning context, never silently interchangeable
Test a boundary case (zero activity gives zero emissions; zero output rejects intensity)
Distinguish the accounting identity from any physical fate, impact or offset claim
starter_sources: https://www.ipcc.ch -- navigate to an assessment-report methodology volume on emission inventories; record exact volume, chapter and table, never cite the root as evidence
No further source URLs were preverified for this assignment; discovery snippets alone do not prove the equation
